Step 1 — Sensible Test

Answer all three. If every answer is No, the argument passes and you are done.
1. Manipulation Check — Is the creator using emotional hijacking, mockery, side-by-side tricks, out-of-context cropping, or coded dog-whistles to force this connection in lieu of evidence?
2. Deception Check — Does a reader have to accept an unproven assumption, a warped timeline, or a structural lie for the child(ren) to successfully connect to the claim?
3. Rhetorical Wrapper Check — Is the visual format being used as a psychological trap to lower the reader's critical thinking, rather than as a helpful tool to illustrate data or literal facts?

Step 2 — Mechanism

At least one check came back Yes, so a mechanism is present. Pick the one that does the most work.
Primary mechanism — which one does most of the work in getting a reader from these children to this claim?
Why that one? Name what in the children is being used and what move it makes toward the claim. Do not restate the label.
